title: Preview or send the daily Clew application email
summary: Show every explicitly tracked application except current rejections, with retained job details and verbatim application notes, in a deterministic personal email.
use_when: Preview, explicitly send, inspect a retained occurrence, or explicitly retry the daily application snapshot.
do_not_use_when: Recording statuses, inferring responses, contacting employers, preparing applications, or sending to other recipients.
outcome: A complete qualifying application snapshot or a frozen email occurrence with provider acceptance or explicit uncertainty.
effects: Reads one Clew ledger snapshot and one complete retained Milieu job snapshot.
Send creates private delivery state, freezes the message and invokes Email. It changes no application records and invokes no model.
authority: The user supplies statuses. Clew owns selection, content, occurrence identity and recovery; Milieu owns job metadata; Email owns transport; Clockwork owns activation and failure halts.
success: Preview returns all qualifying applications and active notes. An acceptance receipt proves provider submission only.
failure_and_recovery: Ledger read failure stops rendering. Missing Milieu context leaves all qualifying jobs visible under their Milieu IDs with a footer.

Uncertain acceptance requires provider inspection and explicit retry of retained bytes within 23 hours. A scheduled failure ends the current send; Clockwork permits later activations before its shared service-health threshold establishes a halt. Healthy or inactive checks clear a pending episode. An established halt requires exact approval.
privacy: Complete selected statuses, notes, company, role and URLs are disclosed through Email to Resend and Gmail. Frozen occurrences remain private and are not automatically pruned.
does_not_authorize: Preview and installation do not authorize mail. An explicit send request or enabled daily binding authorizes this exact content to the fixed personal recipient.
No application status inference, employer contact, ledger mutation or model invocation.

consumers.statement: The local user and authorized agent, or the enabled clew/daily-email binding with standing authority for its fixed digest.

preconditions.statement: New rendering needs readable initialized Clew schema-four state. Context needs the Milieu snapshot reader. Sending needs a private state directory and installed Email with credentials and network access.

inputs.statement: email preview accepts --occurrence ID. email send accepts either --scheduled or --retry ID. Global --state-dir selects private state and --json selects JSON previews and send receipts.

outputs.statement: Commands print readable text by default. --json selects the existing schema-four machine response. Human errors go to stderr with a nonzero exit. JSON errors retain ok:false and error.detail on stdout. Text previews show From, To, Subject and body. With --json, previews return data.digest with application_count, context_available and ledger_sequence. Send returns occurrence and accepted_id or an error.

data_semantics.statement: Only active explicit application-report associations contribute status and notes; generic entries and plain milieu.job links are excluded. Current status uses the last nonnull active report. Only trimmed case-insensitive rejected is excluded. All other supplied statuses remain unchanged; null displays No status recorded. Active application notes are copied in ledger sequence order. Items sort by company, role and opaque Milieu job ID. No application-age, response, or work-completion inference occurs.

identity_and_units.statement: Milieu job IDs identify tracked jobs. Occurrences use manual/UUIDv7 or daily/YYYY-MM-DD for the most recent local 09:00. A random UUID key identifies each frozen payload; attempted_at is UTC Unix seconds. ledger_sequence is the last observed append, not an application date.

completeness_and_freshness.statement: The full ledger is read once. Milieu export is a separate complete retained-data snapshot. Rejected records contribute no counts or notes. Missing metadata does not omit qualifying applications. Frozen occurrences retain their original content after corrections and ledger migration. Provider acceptance is not inbox receipt.

access.statement: The current user reads private state. Only authorized sends disclose content to the fixed Email recipient.

lifecycle_and_consistency.statement: Preview creates no domain state. Sends hold maintenance admission and an email lock, retain payload bytes and attempt admission before transport, and save acceptance afterward. Accepted daily occurrences are not resubmitted. Uncertain attempts require explicit bounded retry. email.sqlite3 uses schema one separately from ledger.sqlite3.

operational_limits.statement: Every qualifying application and active note is included without truncation. An empty snapshot is sent. Daily runs have a 180-second bound; no backlog replay, start-delay, message-size, throughput or final-delivery guarantee is supplied.

compatibility_and_evolution.statement: Ledger and CLI JSON schemas are four; email storage remains schema one. Migration from supported ledger schemas preserves frozen payload bytes, send keys, occurrence identity, and acceptance receipts. Unsupported state fails; no future cross-release support window or provider retention guarantee is promised.

Contract 5 requires --json for the ordinary CLI machine response. The prior JSON success and error shapes and their streams are preserved with that flag. Default readable text does not change persistent state formats or the separate installation and status-snapshot protocols.

reliances.statement: Clew reads retained job metadata through the supported complete Milieu snapshot interface.
Email submits the unchanged payload and stable key to the fixed recipient.
Clockwork activates the installed runner and enforces its shared service-health threshold before new scheduling failure halts.
